title: Deduplicate a type guard without changing behaviour
prompt: Every validator in validators.py opens with the same `isinstance(value, str)` guard. Extract that check into a single shared helper named `_is_str(value)` and have all four validators use it. The observable behaviour of every validator must stay exactly the same — the tests pin the behaviour and check that the duplication is gone. Do not rename the public functions and do not modify the tests.
